# USDA Climate Hubs

> USDA Climate Hubs provides regional climate adaptation support, research, and resources for agriculture, forestry, and rural communities across the United States and internationally.

The USDA Climate Hubs network consists of 10 regional hubs plus international and tribal programs, each tailored to local climate challenges such as wildfire resilience, drought monitoring, forest health, and specialty crop adaptation. The hubs facilitate climate-smart agriculture practices, carbon management, and indigenous knowledge integration to build resilience across diverse agricultural and forest ecosystems.

## Key Topics

- Climate Adaptation
- Climate-Smart Agriculture
- Forest Management
- Wildfire Resilience
- Carbon Management
- Drought Monitoring
- Agriculture Resilience
- Tribal Knowledge
- Regional Climate Hubs
- Specialty Crops
- Climate Projections
- Greenhouse Gases
- Pollinator Conservation
- Livestock Management
- Climate Literacy

## Regional Climate Hubs

- [Welcome to the USDA Climate Hubs](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov): USDA Climate Hubs homepage introducing regional hubs and climate adaptation
- [California Climate Hub](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/hubs/california): California Climate Hub for wildfire resilience and specialty crop adaptation
- [Midwest Climate Hub](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/hubs/midwest): Midwest Climate Hub for North Central agriculture and specialty crop adaptation
- [Northeast Climate Hub](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/hubs/northeast): Northeast Climate Hub for soil health and forest climate management
- [Northwest Climate Hub](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/hubs/northwest): Northwest Climate Hub for carbon management and rangeland resilience
- [Northern Plains Climate Hub](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/hubs/northern-plains): Northern Plains Climate Hub for drought monitoring and livestock ranching
- [Northern Forests Climate Hub](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/hubs/northern-forests): Northern Forests Climate Hub for ecosystem management and forest operations
- [Southeast Climate Hub](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/hubs/southeast): Southeast Climate Hub for forest health and hurricane resilience
- [Southern Plains Climate Hub](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/hubs/southern-plains): Southern Plains Climate Hub for wildfire/flood risk and rainwater harvesting
- [Southwest Climate Hub](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/hubs/southwest): Southwest Climate Hub for wildfire resilience and tribal knowledge integration
- [Caribbean Climate Hub](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/hubs/caribbean): Caribbean Climate Hub supporting Puerto Rico and US Virgin Islands recovery

## Climate Solutions & Priorities

- [Climate Solutions](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/priorities/climate-solutions): Climate solutions for resilience, emissions reduction, and carbon storage
- [Climate Vulnerabilities](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/priorities/climate-vulnerabilities): Regional vulnerability assessments and climate change impact strategies
- [Climate Literacy & Training](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/priorities/climate-literacy-training): Climate literacy training and workshops for farmers, foresters, and managers
- [Tribal Nations](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/priorities/tribal-nations): Climate support for Tribal Nations and indigenous knowledge integration

## Global & Partnership Resources

- [International Climate Hub](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/hubs/international): International Climate Hub sharing research and climate-smart agriculture globally
- [Partnering Agencies](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/agency): USDA interagency collaboration structure and Forest Service partnerships

## Topic Reference & Research

- [Greenhouse Gases](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/taxonomy/term/504): Greenhouse gas emissions data and agriculture/forestry carbon impacts
- [Pollinators](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/topics/pollinators): Pollinator climate impacts and native habitat conservation strategies
- [Animals](https://www.climatehubs.usda.gov/commodity/animals): Livestock agriculture climate impacts and adaptive management practices
